project.name: Research Audit Workbench
project.summary: A WebMCP-enabled experiment workbench for early-career ML researchers that imports persistent run records, audits comparison fairness across metadata, and requires human approval before saving agent findings or experiment plans.
project.ai_usage: An external browser agent uses six WebMCP tools to inspect live comparison state, review decision readiness, and stage reversible work; deterministic application code owns facts, evidence, and validation.
project.codex_usage: Codex shaped the scope and architecture, implemented and debugged the vertical slices, configured deployment, and ran local and public verification.
